payload.rationale: The user revised the execution direction on 2026-09-10: use each supported host's native Node runner and configured permissions, preserve exact mutation and validator integrity, cancellation, truthful observations and recovery, and stop requiring Projector-owned confinement or a Windows-to-WSL bridge. Earlier evaluated alternatives and bounded probe results remain in authenticated record history and the alternatives above; they do not create a standing sandbox research obligation. Host execution improves reach and packaging simplicity but does not prevent malicious same-user tampering, deny network, hide undeclared paths, or create immutable overlays unless the actual host separately enforces those properties.
